verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              प्राप्तमप्रतिमं दुःखं रामेण भरतर्षभ। रक्षसा जानकी तस्य हृता भार्या बलीयसा॥१॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : O foremost of the Bharatas, an incomparable calamity was met with by Rama. His wife Janaki was carried away by force by the Rakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमाद्राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना। मायामास्थाय तरसा हत्वा गृध्रं जटायुषम्॥२॥
verses.english: Resorting to Maya and having slain the vulture Jatayu, the vicious-souled Ravana, the king of Rakshasas (carried her away) from the hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्याजहार तां रामः सुग्रीवबलमाश्रितः। बद्ध्वा सेतुं समुद्रस्य दग्ध्वा लङ्कां शितैः शरैः॥३॥
verses.english: Constructing a bridge over the ocean and burn in down Lanka with sharp shafts, by the help of Sugriva, Rama brought her back.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              कस्मिन् रामः कुले जातः किंवीर्यः किम्पराक्रमः। रावणः कस्य पुत्रो वा किं वैरं तस्य तेन ह॥४॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said: In what family was be born? How was his mighty and prowess? Whose son was Rama? What enmity had he with him?

verses.sanskrit: एतन्मे भगवन् सर्वं सम्यगाख्यातुमर्हसि। श्रोतुमिच्छामि चरितं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः॥५॥
verses.english: Oh Sir, relate ail this to me. I wish to hear the story of Rama of unwearied actions.

verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              अजो नामाऽभवद्राजा महानिक्ष्वाकुवंशजः। तस्य पुत्रो दशरथः शश्वत् स्वाध्यायवाञ्छुचिः॥६॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : There was a great king in the family of Ikshvakus by name Aja. His son was Dasharatha, who was pure and ever devoted to the study of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: अभवंस्तस्य चत्वारः पुत्रा धर्मार्थकोविदाः। रामलक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्ना भरतश्च महाबलः॥७॥
verses.english: He had four sons well-versed in Dharma and Artha namely Rama, Lakshmana, Shatrughna and the mighty Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्य माता कौसल्या कैकेयी भरतस्य तु। सुतौ लक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्नौ सुमित्रायाः परन्तपौ॥८॥
verses.english: Rama's mother was Kausalaya, Bharata's mother was Kaikeyi and Sumitra was the mother of Lakshmana and Shatrughana, the repressors of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: विदेहराजो जनकः सीता तस्यात्मजा विभो। यां चकार स्वयं त्वष्टा रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्॥९॥
verses.english: O lord, Janaka was the king of Videha and his daughter was Sita. Tvashtri himself created her wishing to make her the beloved queen of Rama.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्रामस्य ते जन्म सीतायाश्च प्रकीर्तितम्। रावणस्यापि ते जन्म व्याख्यास्यामि जनेश्वर॥१०॥
verses.english: I have thus recounted to you the birth of Rama and Sita; O lord of men, I shall now describe the birth of Ravana.
verses.bhavadeepa: त्वष्टा प्रजापतिः स्वयमेव सङ्कल्पेन चकार न तु मैथुनद्वारा । अयोनिजामित्यर्थः ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: पितामहो रावणस्य साक्षाद्देवः प्रजापतिः। स्वयम्भूः सर्वलोकानां प्रभुः स्रष्टा महातपाः॥११॥
verses.english: Prajapati himself, the self-create, the creator, the Lord of creatures, of great exertions, is the grand-father of Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यो नाम तस्यासीन्मानसो दयितः सुतः। तस्य वैश्रवणो नाम गवि पुत्रोऽभवत् प्रभुः॥१२॥
verses.english: Prajapati had a favourite son born of his mind by name Pulastya; and he had a powerful son begotten of cow by name Vaishravana.

verses.sanskrit: पितरं स समुत्सृज्य पितामहमुपस्थितः। तस्य कोपात् पिता राजन् ससर्जात्मानमात्मना॥१३॥
verses.english: Leaving his father he went to his grandfather. Accordingly worked up with anger, O king, he created a second self of himself.

verses.sanskrit: स जज्ञे विश्रवा नाम तस्यात्मार्धेन वै द्विजः। प्रतीकाराय सक्रोधस्ततो वैश्रवणस्य वै॥१४॥
verses.english: Thereupon for wrecking vengeance on Vaishravana in great anger that regenerate one, with half of his own self, created Vaishravana.
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्य वैश्रवणस्य कोपात् मां त्यक्त्वा मत्पितरं सेवत इत्यतिज्वलनात् वैश्रवणं बाधितुं पुलस्त्य एव योगबलेन विश्रवःसंज्ञं देहान्तरं चक्रे इत्यर्थः ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: पितामहस्तु प्रीतात्मा ददौ वैश्रवणस्य ह। अमरत्वं धनेशत्वं लोकपालत्वमेव च॥१५॥
verses.english: (However) pleased, the grand-father conferred on Vaishravana immortality, the sovereignty of all wealth and guardianship of one of the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानेन तथा सख्यं पुत्रं च नलकूबरम्। राजधानीनिवेशं च लङ्कां रक्षोगणान्विताम्॥१६॥
verses.english: The friendship with Ishana and a son named Nalakubera. He created Lanka as his capital protected by Rakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: विमानं पुष्पकं नाम कामगं च ददौ प्रभुः। यक्षाणामाधिपत्यं च राजराजत्वमेव च॥१७॥
verses.english: The Lord gave him a chariot coursing at will by name Pushpaka, the sovereignty over he Yakshas and the supremacy over kings.
